newsitem.title: USA: Greif sees FY97 hurt by excess capacity.
newsitem.headline: Greif sees FY97 hurt by excess capacity.

text.p: Excess containerboard capacity will hurt Greif Bros Corp results in fiscal 1997, the company's chairman and chief executive officer said Monday.

"Fiscal 1997 results will be adversely affected by excess capacity of containerboard. This has resulted in prices reaching an 18-year low," Michael J. Gasser said at the company's annual meeting in Wilmington, Del.
At the meeting, Greif announced the re-election of all 10 directors, for a one-year term. There were no other items to be voted on.
Greif Bros Corp manufactures and markets industrial packaging and components.
The company has operations in the United States and Canada.
